== Strategy ==

My first attempt at a Walkers deck... be kind.  >:)

Main focus is to blow the Generators, then drain and cause direct damage.  So far I see a LOT of flaws in this deck's design, and could use some help plugging those holes.  Here we go with the two biggies:

1) Not enough characters.  14 characters may be a decent number if we're talking about a Mains & Toys or manip deck, but not something like walkers...  the walkers are taking up a lot of space, and most will probably get pulled.

2) Destiny sucks.  The average destiny number of this deck is barely over 2... the main problem is the walkers and the characters.  Once again, some of the walkers will probably get pulled.

Another problem I'm having is trying to figure out what else to have the deck DO.  Sure, draining and causing damage sounds good on paper, but it mainly depends on the Presence Of The Force's getting on table and not being cancelled.  I'd definitely like a better interrupt selection (possibly an Artillery or two, among other things), but can't really think of much that fits with the design.

Help would definitely be appreciated.  Thanks!

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
